data.title: 中野四叶 · 晴空天台的元气便当
data.description: 放学后的明媚天台上微风和煦，四叶坐在木长椅上大口咬着美味饭团。鼓起腮帮子露出天真灿烂的笑容，挥手招呼少年过来一起吃。
data.action: sitting on bench, holding onigiri, stuffed cheeks, cheerful grin
data.lighting: fresh afternoon breeze and clear sky
data.promptProse: Sitting on a wooden bench on the school rooftop, Nakano Yotsuba munches happily on a large rice ball with full puffy cheeks. Her green rabbit ribbon sways softly in the gentle breeze against the chainlink fence and blue sky.
data.animaCaption: Sitting on the sunny rooftop bench with cheeks puffed from onigiri, she waves with a bright cheerful smile.
